facts.value: As part of your study program at our Department of Economics, you can take certain modules at other departments, known as import modules from other departments - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between departments.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: For the study programs of the Department of Economics, it is compiled in the following overview which import modules you can register at other departments and how you can incorporate these import modules into your study program at the Department of Economics.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: Additionally, you cannot incorporate any other modules from other departments into your study program at the Department of Economics and cannot earn any differing credit points (CP).
